title: Ordeal test suite
description: A sidecar test suite for a Sigma detection rule, named <rule>.test.yml and stored next to the rule it tests. Ordeal rejects unknown keys, so this schema is closed at every level.

rule.description: Path to the Sigma rule under test, relative to this suite file.

config.description: Optional sigma-go field-mapping config paths, relative to this suite file, applied in order.

mutate.description: Set false to opt this suite out of adversarial mutation. Defaults to true.

cases.description: The expectations this suite asserts. At least one is required.

case.title: Test case
case.description: One expectation: an event, or a dataset of events, plus the verdict it must produce.

name.description: Unique name for this case within the suite. Name the behavior, not the rule.

dataset.description: Path to a telemetry file, relative to this suite file. Every event in the file must produce the expected verdict. Accepts .json, .jsonl, and .ndjson.

match.description: The expected verdict. Defaults to true.

selections.description: Named selections from the rule's detection block that must have fired. Valid only on an inline case with match true.

allOf.$comment: selections cannot be asserted when the rule is expected not to fire.
selections cannot be asserted on a dataset case.

event.title: Event
event.description: A flat event keyed by Sigma taxonomy field names, as the rule expects them after any configs are applied.
